caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, ornately decorated box and a separate close-up view of its rear panel. The box is rendered in shades of brown and gray, with subtle highlights that indicate a metallic or aged wooden surface. The front and sides of the box are decorated with raised five-pointed stars, and the front face features a large bird, likely a dove, carrying a branch in its beak, positioned between the stars. The lid of the box is slanted and features a raised, stylized feather or leaf design. Below the box, the drawing includes a detailed view labeled "Rear Elevation," which shows a panel with a heart in the center pierced by an arrow running horizontally through it. This rear panel is bordered with a patterned edge. The artist’s name, "Adele Brooks," is written at the bottom right corner of the image. The overall composition is presented on a plain, light background.
title: Pa. German Bridal Box
